body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoW2ZofqGMQSDVfkZdFAsKUR)_

Part of #32979

## What changes

Removes `docs/design/exclusion-constraints.md`, the step-1 design for a declarative `exclusions` key that landed in 7257f57a (#33190). This is a plain `git revert` of that commit; nothing else in the repository references the file.

## Why

The maintainer ruled on the card (ruling comment 6876330213) that overlapping-booking rules stay in hook scripts for now: no `exclusions` key and no kernel change, with a vetted hook template to follow in a separate docs change. The design doc describes the option that was not adopted, so leaving it under `docs/design/` would read as a plan of record. The maintainer asked for this revert directly in the project thread:

> 回退设计稿，让座位现在就处理

The hook-template work stays queued on #32979.

## Verification

- `git grep -n exclusion-constraints` on this head: no hits.
- Diff is one file, 235 deletions, no other paths.
- Publishes nothing from any released package, so this carries `skip-changeset`.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除 `docs/design/exclusion-constraints.md`，即 #33190 落地的「声明式 exclusions 键」设计稿；一个文件、235 行删除，等同 `git revert 7257f57a`。
- 为什么改：你在 #32979 裁定「脚本模板，内核不动」，不做 exclusions 键；设计稿留在 `docs/design/` 会被当成待实施计划。
- 风险与回滚：无运行时影响，仓内无任何引用（`git grep` 零命中）；要恢复就 revert 本提交。
- 先看：`docs/design/exclusion-constraints.md`（唯一文件，整篇删除）。
- 两分钟验证：合并后跑 `git grep -n exclusion-constraints origin/main`，应无输出。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：ACCEPT。同一会话起草并落地，依据是你在项目线程里的原话「回退设计稿，让座位现在就处理」；非受管面、未触 `packages/spec`，不需要条款②复核。

- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (n/a: publishes nothing, `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (n/a: not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
